≈60–814 h per participant (calculated from Table 4)

Calculated from descriptor v2 Table 4 recording-hour cells: P01 ≈813.8 h, P02 ≈146.2 h, P03 ≈60.3 h. The shared covert-repetition/listening recordings are counted once. Rounded cells sum to 1,020.3 h versus Table 3’s 1,020.4 h; the plotted abstract total stays 1,020 h. JapanEEG descriptor — primary source ↗

Author-reported controlled-access repository: Harvard Dataverse · JapanEEG (files not inspected) ↗

Abstract: “1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio”. In descriptor v2 (November 17, 2026), authors report controlled access through Harvard Dataverse, with voice-masked audio. The point retains initial descriptor submission timing; archive upload timing remains unverified. Version 2 adds current access and duration evidence. Duration counts simultaneous modalities once; the release manifest remains unenumerated.
